responses.vision: Empower distributed teams to coordinate effortlessly across timezones by making temporal awareness a first-class element of task management. Every team member should be able to see at a glance when their colleagues are available, hand off work seamlessly across timezone boundaries, and never miss a deadline because of a timezone miscalculation.

target_users.name: Distributed Team Lead
target_users.role: Engineering manager or team lead responsible for coordinating work across 3+ timezones
pain_points: Spends 30+ minutes daily manually calculating timezone overlaps for meetings and handoffs
Misses optimal collaboration windows because team availability is not visible at a glance
Struggles to assign tasks fairly across timezones without overburdening certain regions
Lacks visibility into whether async handoffs are happening smoothly or creating bottlenecks
goals: Reduce coordination overhead to under 10 minutes per day
Ensure equitable workload distribution across all timezone groups
Achieve smooth async handoffs with clear context transfer between shifts
Have real-time visibility into team-wide progress regardless of timezone

target_users.name: Remote Individual Contributor
target_users.role: Developer, designer, or analyst working in a different timezone from the majority of their team
pain_points: Frequently receives meeting invitations outside working hours
Blocks on tasks because the person who can unblock them is asleep
Misses real-time discussions that happen during other timezone's peak hours
Feels isolated from team decisions made during synchronous sessions
goals: Receive notifications and requests only during working hours
Have clear async handoff protocols so work continues while they sleep
Stay informed about team decisions without attending every synchronous meeting
Feel equally included in team processes regardless of timezone location

target_users.name: Operations Director
target_users.role: Senior leader overseeing multiple distributed teams across the organization
pain_points: Cannot get a consolidated view of productivity across timezone-distributed teams
Difficult to identify timezone-related bottlenecks in project delivery
Lacks data to make informed decisions about team composition across regions
Existing tools do not surface timezone-specific collaboration metrics
goals: Dashboard showing collaboration health metrics across all teams and timezones
Data-driven insights for optimizing team timezone composition
Standardized async handoff processes across the organization
Reduced project delivery delays attributable to timezone coordination failures

problem_statements: Distributed teams lose an average of 4+ hours per week to timezone-related coordination friction, including scheduling conflicts, missed handoffs, and delayed feedback
Existing project management tools treat timezone as display metadata rather than a workflow-aware dimension, forcing teams to manage timezone complexity manually
Team leads lack visibility into timezone-specific bottlenecks, making it impossible to optimize task assignment and handoff timing
Individual contributors in minority timezones experience disproportionate meeting burden and information asymmetry

functional_requirements.title: Timezone Overlap Heatmap
functional_requirements.description: Display an interactive heatmap showing overlapping working hours across all team members, highlighting optimal windows for synchronous collaboration

functional_requirements.title: Timezone-Aware Task Assignment
functional_requirements.description: When assigning tasks, display each assignee's current local time, working hours status, and upcoming availability. Warn if a deadline falls outside the assignee's working hours.

functional_requirements.title: Async Handoff Workflows
functional_requirements.description: Enable structured handoffs between timezone groups with automatic context bundling, status summaries, and clear next-action indicators for the receiving team

functional_requirements.title: Smart Meeting Scheduler
functional_requirements.description: Suggest optimal meeting times based on participant timezone overlap, working hour preferences, and existing calendar commitments

functional_requirements.title: Working Hours Configuration
functional_requirements.description: Allow each team member to set their timezone, working hours, and preferred meeting windows. Support flexible schedules and non-standard working hour patterns.

functional_requirements.title: Task Board with Timezone Context
functional_requirements.description: Standard kanban/list view for tasks with timezone-aware annotations: assignee local time, time-until-deadline in assignee's timezone, and handoff indicators

functional_requirements.title: Notification Scheduling
functional_requirements.description: Queue and deliver notifications according to each recipient's working hours. Urgent notifications can override; non-urgent notifications are batched for delivery at the start of the recipient's next working period.

functional_requirements.title: Slack Integration
functional_requirements.description: Bidirectional integration with Slack: receive task updates, create tasks from Slack messages, and query timezone overlap from within Slack channels

functional_requirements.title: Calendar Integration
functional_requirements.description: Read-only integration with Google Calendar and Outlook to factor existing commitments into scheduling suggestions and availability calculations

functional_requirements.title: Team Analytics Dashboard
functional_requirements.description: Visualize collaboration metrics: timezone overlap utilization, handoff completion rates, average response times by timezone pair, and meeting hour distribution fairness

functional_requirements.title: GitHub Integration
functional_requirements.description: Link tasks to GitHub issues and pull requests. Surface PR review assignments with timezone context to reduce review turnaround time.

functional_requirements.title: Mobile Companion App
functional_requirements.description: Lightweight mobile application for checking team availability, responding to handoff notifications, and updating task status on the go

non_functional_requirements.title: Performance
non_functional_requirements.description: Page load time under 2 seconds for the main dashboard. Timezone overlap calculations must complete in under 200ms for teams of up to 100 members.

non_functional_requirements.title: Data Privacy
non_functional_requirements.description: Calendar data is processed in-session only and not stored permanently. Working hours and timezone data is stored with appropriate access controls. GDPR-compliant data handling.

non_functional_requirements.title: Availability
non_functional_requirements.description: 99.5% uptime SLA. Graceful degradation when third-party integrations are unavailable.

non_functional_requirements.title: Accessibility
non_functional_requirements.description: WCAG 2.1 AA compliance. All timezone visualizations must have text-based alternatives. Color choices must be distinguishable for colorblind users.

non_functional_requirements.title: Scalability
non_functional_requirements.description: Support up to 10,000 concurrent users and organizations with up to 500 team members without performance degradation.

user_stories.i_want: to see a visual heatmap of my team's overlapping working hours
user_stories.so_that: I can identify the best windows for synchronous collaboration without manually calculating timezone offsets
acceptance_criteria: Heatmap displays all team members grouped by timezone
Overlapping hours are highlighted with intensity proportional to the number of available members
Clicking a time slot shows which specific members are available
Heatmap updates automatically when team composition or working hours change

user_stories.i_want: to receive task notifications only during my configured working hours
user_stories.so_that: I am not disturbed outside work and can start my day with a clear summary of overnight activity
acceptance_criteria: Non-urgent notifications are queued and delivered at the start of the user's working hours
Urgent notifications can be configured to override the quiet period
A morning digest summarizes all queued notifications, handoffs, and task updates
Users can configure their notification preferences and quiet hours independently

user_stories.i_want: to create an async handoff when my sub-team finishes its work for the day
user_stories.so_that: the next timezone group can pick up exactly where we left off without losing context
acceptance_criteria: Handoff includes a structured summary of completed work, blockers, and next actions
The receiving team gets a notification at the start of their working hours
Handoff status is tracked: created, acknowledged, in-progress, completed
Historical handoffs are searchable for retrospective analysis

user_stories.i_want: to be warned when I assign a task with a deadline that falls outside the assignee's working hours
user_stories.so_that: I can adjust the deadline or reassign to someone in a more appropriate timezone
acceptance_criteria: Warning appears during task assignment if the deadline is outside assignee working hours
Suggestion is offered for the nearest working-hours-compatible deadline
Alternative assignees in compatible timezones are suggested
Warning can be acknowledged and overridden with a reason

user_stories.i_want: to view collaboration health metrics across all my distributed teams
user_stories.so_that: I can identify timezone-related bottlenecks and make data-driven staffing decisions
acceptance_criteria: Dashboard shows average handoff completion time by timezone pair
Meeting hour distribution fairness score is displayed per team
Timezone overlap utilization rate is tracked over time
Filters allow drilling down by team, time period, and timezone region

user_stories.i_want: to see what happened on shared tasks while I was offline
user_stories.so_that: I can quickly catch up on progress and understand what needs my attention
acceptance_criteria: Activity feed shows task updates, comments, and status changes since last visit
Items requiring action are highlighted separately from informational updates
Feed is filterable by project, team, and update type
Time is displayed in the viewer's local timezone

user_stories.i_want: to schedule a meeting that works for participants across multiple timezones
user_stories.so_that: I do not accidentally schedule during someone's night hours or create an unfair meeting burden
acceptance_criteria: Scheduler shows a visual comparison of all participants' working hours
Optimal time slots are ranked by number of participants within working hours
Fairness indicator shows how meeting times distribute across timezone groups over time
Integration with Google Calendar and Outlook shows existing commitments

user_stories.i_want: to integrate task updates with our Slack workspace
user_stories.so_that: team members receive relevant updates in the tool they already use throughout the day
acceptance_criteria: Task status changes are posted to a configurable Slack channel
Team members can create tasks from Slack messages via a slash command
Timezone overlap queries can be run from Slack
Notification preferences in the app control what is sent to Slack

feature_priorities.rationale: Core differentiator and primary activation feature. Provides immediate visible value in the first session.
Foundation for daily use. Without task management, the product is a visualization tool rather than a workflow platform.
Highest-value unmet need identified in research. Key differentiator from existing project management tools.
Addresses one of the most frequent timezone pain points. Drives daily engagement and habit formation.
Prerequisite for all timezone-aware features. Also directly addresses minority-timezone contributor pain.
Primary distribution channel for adoption. Teams that integrate with Slack show 2.5x higher retention in comparable SaaS products.
Improves scheduling accuracy significantly. Required data source for smart meeting suggestions.
Valuable for team leads and operations directors but not required for initial adoption. Strong upsell feature for premium tier.
Enhances value for developer teams but narrows the addressable market if prioritized too early.

success_metrics: 70% of trial teams complete the timezone overlap heatmap setup within the first session
Teams using async handoffs report a 30% reduction in self-reported timezone coordination friction within 4 weeks
Average daily active usage exceeds 3 sessions per user per day within teams that have adopted the task board
Free-to-paid conversion rate exceeds 5% within the first 90 days
Net Promoter Score above 40 among teams spanning 3+ timezones
Less than 5% monthly churn rate for paid teams after the first 3 months
out_of_scope: Full project management suite (Gantt charts, resource planning, budget tracking)
Native mobile applications (responsive web in MVP, native apps deferred)
Video conferencing or real-time communication features
AI-powered task auto-assignment or workload optimization
Custom workflow automation or scripting engine
Integration with more than 3 external platforms in the MVP

responses.vision: Create the definitive coordination platform for teams that work across time boundaries. {{project_name}} transforms timezone complexity from a daily friction point into a seamless, invisible part of how distributed teams collaborate and deliver.

target_users.name: Startup CTO
target_users.role: Technical co-founder managing a remote engineering team of 8-25 across multiple countries
pain_points: Context is lost between timezone shifts, causing duplicated work and missed blockers
Sprint ceremonies are scheduled at inconvenient times for at least one timezone group
Cannot gauge team velocity accurately because timezone handoff delays skew delivery metrics
Recruiting internationally increases timezone complexity faster than coordination capability grows
goals: Ship features at a predictable cadence regardless of team timezone distribution
Make timezone-distributed code review cycles as fast as co-located ones
Reduce the overhead of managing timezone complexity as the team grows
Attract global talent by demonstrating effective distributed work practices

target_users.name: Distributed Product Designer
target_users.role: Senior designer working 8 timezones away from the majority of the product team
pain_points: Design reviews happen during hours when they are offline, leading to feedback delays
Cannot participate in real-time brainstorming sessions with the core team
Handoff to developers lacks the context that a quick conversation would provide
Feels out of the loop on priority changes decided in synchronous meetings
goals: Have async-first design review workflows that do not require real-time presence
Receive structured daily briefings on decisions and priority changes
Hand off designs with sufficient context that developers rarely need follow-up questions
Contribute equally to team decisions despite timezone separation

problem_statements: Distributed teams treat timezone management as an afterthought rather than a core workflow concern, resulting in systemic productivity losses
No existing tool provides timezone-aware task lifecycle management — from assignment through handoff to completion
Individual contributors in distant timezones bear disproportionate costs in meeting burden and information lag

functional_requirements.title: Team Timezone Map
functional_requirements.description: Visual representation of all team members positioned on a world timezone view, showing current local time, working status (active/offline/meeting), and available overlap windows

functional_requirements.title: Task Management with Timezone Annotations
functional_requirements.description: Create, assign, and track tasks with timezone-aware features: local deadline display, working-hours warnings, and timezone-relative priority sorting

functional_requirements.title: Structured Async Handoffs
functional_requirements.description: End-of-shift workflow that bundles completed work, open blockers, and context notes into a handoff package delivered to the next timezone group at the start of their working hours

functional_requirements.title: Timezone-Fair Meeting Scheduler
functional_requirements.description: Automated meeting time suggestions that optimize for participant working hours, track historical meeting time distribution, and flag timezone-unfair patterns

functional_requirements.title: Activity Digest
functional_requirements.description: Personalized daily digest delivered at the start of each user's working hours, summarizing relevant task updates, handoffs, decisions, and items requiring action

functional_requirements.title: Slack Bot
functional_requirements.description: Slack integration for querying team availability, creating tasks, and receiving handoff notifications within the team's primary communication tool

functional_requirements.title: Collaboration Metrics
functional_requirements.description: Dashboard showing handoff turnaround times, cross-timezone response latencies, and meeting fairness scores

non_functional_requirements.title: Response Time
non_functional_requirements.description: API responses under 500ms at the 95th percentile. Dashboard renders in under 1.5 seconds.

non_functional_requirements.title: Security
non_functional_requirements.description: SOC2 Type I aligned security practices. All data encrypted in transit and at rest. OAuth 2.0 for all third-party integrations.

non_functional_requirements.title: Timezone Correctness
non_functional_requirements.description: All timezone calculations must use the latest IANA timezone database. DST transitions must be handled correctly for all supported regions. Edge cases (half-hour offsets, regions that do not observe DST) must be explicitly tested.

non_functional_requirements.title: Internationalization
non_functional_requirements.description: UI must support date/time formatting according to user locale. Support for right-to-left layouts is desirable but not required for MVP.

user_stories.i_want: to see which of my team members are currently online and available across all timezones
user_stories.so_that: I can make real-time decisions about who to pull into an urgent discussion or task
acceptance_criteria: Team map shows real-time availability status for all members
Current local time is displayed for each timezone group
Members are visually grouped by timezone proximity
Status updates are reflected within 30 seconds

user_stories.i_want: to create a handoff package at the end of my work day that includes design decisions, open questions, and linked files
user_stories.so_that: the engineering team in the next timezone can continue implementation without waiting for me to come back online
acceptance_criteria: Handoff includes a text summary, linked tasks, and file attachments
Recipients are notified at the start of their working hours
Handoff has a status tracker: sent, viewed, acknowledged, completed
Templates can be saved for recurring handoff patterns

user_stories.i_want: to see a report on how meeting times are distributed across timezone groups over the past month
user_stories.so_that: I can identify and correct patterns where certain timezones bear an unfair meeting burden
acceptance_criteria: Report shows meeting count and total hours per timezone group
Fairness score indicates how evenly meetings are distributed
Report can be filtered by meeting type (standup, review, planning)
Recommendations are provided for rebalancing meeting times

user_stories.i_want: to receive a morning digest of everything that happened on my projects while I was offline
user_stories.so_that: I can start my work day informed and focused without scrolling through hours of notifications
acceptance_criteria: Digest is delivered at the configured start of working hours
Content is prioritized: action items first, then decisions, then informational updates
Digest includes links to relevant tasks, handoffs, and discussions
Users can customize digest content and delivery format

feature_priorities.rationale: The hero feature that demonstrates value in the first 30 seconds. Essential for product-led growth.
The daily-use foundation. Without it, the product is a dashboard rather than a workflow tool.
The highest-value unique capability. Addresses the most painful unmet need in the market.
High frequency use case that drives habit formation and daily engagement.
Important for retention — ensures value delivery even on days without active task management.
Key adoption driver that meets users in their existing workflow.
Premium feature for team leads and management. Strong upsell potential but not required for core value.

success_metrics: 60% of new teams set up their timezone map and add all members within the first day
Teams that use handoffs show 40% faster cross-timezone turnaround times within 30 days
Weekly active user rate exceeds 80% among team members in the first 60 days
Trial-to-paid conversion rate of 6% or higher for teams using the product for 14+ days
Average session duration exceeds 5 minutes, indicating active use beyond passive dashboard viewing
Customer acquisition cost below $150 per team within the first year
out_of_scope: Custom automation rules or workflow scripting
Native desktop or mobile applications in the initial release
Multi-language UI support beyond English in the initial release
